title: Fixed Side Finger Bar and Opposed Knife Sections Mower
description: One newly authored whole parked side finger-bar mower-style implement. One complete long horizontal bar reaches laterally from a low inner drive-head exterior to a full outer shoe and raised crop-divider fin. Eighteen complete narrow blunt guard fingers and seventeen complete broader blunt triangular knife-section appearances alternate along the front of the whole bar, with a full continuous rear knife strip and six small hold-down clips; none are extracted from another model. A full inner shoe, an independent rear parking foot, low cross hitch beam and complete raised triangular attachment-style frame support the whole machine in this fixed display pose. A full enclosed shaped drive case, proud round head cover, short shielded input exterior and fixed diagonal lifting link complete the left head region. All visible geometry newly authored; no flail rotor, reel mower, combine header, sickle blade or hitch frame imported. Structurally distinct from the existing rotating-reel mower and the cutaway cylindrical Y-flail mower: this is a single long side-reaching comb with alternating flat guard and knife-section silhouettes and no rotor or wheels. One model zero scenes. All tips deliberately thick and blunt, fixed without operating clearances. No tractor, crop, actual gearing, functional cutting edge, reciprocation, motion sweep, blade/shear fit, drive transmission, hitch compatibility, crop flow, load, hydraulic or spring performance, manufacture, engineering or machine-safety claim. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
